NCCIH Consumer Guide: Herbs at a Glance & Safety Considerations | Publisher: National Cent
Common Natural Products & Evidence Status
Overview of common dietary products: - Ginger: Evidence supports ginger
for mild nausea related to motion or pregnancy. Use in moderate food-level
amounts. - Chamomile: Commonly used as tea for mild relaxation. Caution in
individuals allergic to ragweed. - Peppermint Oil: Enteric-coated
peppermint oil may ease mild IBS symptoms. Avoid unformulated raw oil
ingestion.
